notes: French/English searches and local-language query variants surfaced a recurring Kétou lead connected in snippets to customs motorcycle checks/seizures. Bénin Web TV (S047), Africaxó (S111), and two L’Investigateur URLs (S112, S165) are preserved as discovery leads. Snippets refer to an encounter and injuries, including one account attributed to local authorities, but none is treated as body-level event evidence. Three exact URLs (S047, S111, S165) returned HTTP 403 after their fresh checks; their earlier Cache-miss/DNS failures are also preserved. S112 produced no readable body after two web.open attempts and an ordinary HTTPS DNS failure. No article body was read. The two L’Investigateur links share a publisher and are not counted as independent; the other source origins are unknown. The February 1 date, occurrence, public-assembly/protest character, attendance, demand, violence, state response, and physical end remain unverified. This is a search lead, not a confirmed episode or start date.
